P.name: Carnivore
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Cho'Gath''' kills an enemy, it {{tip|heals}} for {{pplevel|18 to 52|color=heal}} and restores {{as|{{sti|mana|{{pplevel|4.72 to 9.48}} mana}}}}.

Q.name: Rupture
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' ruptures the target location after a {{rutngt|0.625}} delay, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for 1 second, and afterwards {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 60% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

W.name: Feral Scream
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' roars in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: Enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{ui|Rift Scuttler|Rift Scuttlers}} hit are also {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.

E.name: Vorpal Spikes
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' empowers its next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 6 seconds to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and launch a blast of spikes {{tip|on-attack}} in the target's direction. Enemies struck are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. The damage is modified against {{tip|monsters}}.
E.description2: The width of the blast of spikes increases based on '''Cho'Gath's''' character {{tip|size}} modifier when they launch, including but not limited to the bonus from ''{{ai|Feast|Cho'Gath|Feast}}'' stacks.
E.description3: ''Vorpal Spikes {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Cho'Gath's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Feast
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cho'Gath''' attempts to eat the target enemy, dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. Against non-{{tip|champions}}, the '''base''' damage is modified.
R.leveling:
{{st|Champion True Damage|{{ap|300|475|650}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Non-Champion True Damage|1200 {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description2: If the target is killed, '''Cho'Gath''' gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Feast''. Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}} or {{tip|minion|minions}}.
R.description3: Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the cast range of the ability by {{fd|2.5}}, for a maximum increase of 25 at 10 stacks, and grants '''Cho'Gath''' {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}} as well as {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and increased {{tip|size}}, capping at {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}} and 100% increased size.
